title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_02.txt
concise_summary: PKD constructs a systematic theology of the Second Advent based on seven signs (Nixon's overthrow, the St. Sophia prophecy, coded messages in 'Tears', his 2-74 visions). He argues that the resurrection of early Christians like Thomas as 'homoplasmates' (restored pre-fall humans bonded to modern hosts) proves the End Times are underway. This restoration unfolds in causal sequence: physical resurrection of the apostolic dead, restoration to the original unfallen nature ('Bright Nature'), defeat of the Black Iron Prison/Cave of Treasures, and the visible return of the rightful King.
key_claims: Seven overwhelming signs confirm the Second Advent has occurred: Nixon's overthrow, the St. Sophia prophecy, the 'Tears' code and dream, the AI voice experience of 2-74-75, and the Head Apollo prophecy.

The homoplasmate is an early Christian (specifically Thomas) resurrected and bonded to PKD's physical body, restoring humanity to its pre-fall unfallen state with enhanced perceptual and cognitive faculties.
Real apostolic time resumed in 1974 after being frozen since ca. AD 45; God's inbreaking through the golden fish symbol (Christ) restarted the actual flow of history.
Salvation is not merit-based but predestined; the initiative is entirely God's, grounded in inscrutable will rather than human acts, following Pauline and Augustinian doctrine.

The sequence 1) physical resurrection, 2) restoration to Bright Nature, 3) defeat of Satan/BIP, 4) return of Rex Felix forms the complete New Testament kerygma, with causal and chronological connections.
The Garden exists as both a place (a level beyond the Cave) and a perceptual state of vastly expanded vision and temporal extension spanning 2000 years of reality.
recurring_concepts: Homoplasmate: the unfallen or restored human, created by bonding an early Christian plasmate to a modern homo (physical host)
Syzygy: the unitary union of Thomas (divine/plasmate aspect) and Phil (physical/homo aspect) as a single salvific entity
Black Iron Prison (BIP) / Cave of Treasures: the fallen material reality in which humanity is imprisoned after the Fall
Plasmate vs. Homo: the spiritual (plasmate, like Thomas) and physical (homo, Phil) components that together form the homoplasmate
Bright Nature: the lost divine attribute of unfallen perception and cognition, restored through resurrection and Christ's mediation
PTG (probably 'Platonic Transcendent Garden'): the original home, the Garden-state freed from the prison's occlusion
Zebra: identified here as Christ or God's cosmic macrobrain actively melting the iron prison
Anamnesis: the remembering of one's apostolic identity (Thomas remembering he lived in Rome ca. AD 45)
people_entities: Thomas: early Christian apostle, resurrected and bonded to PKD as the plasmate/divine component
Phil / Philip K. Dick: PKD himself, the human host (homo) bonded to Thomas
Christ: invoked as Advocate and the golden fish sign triggering the restoration
Nixon: Richard Nixon, whose political overthrow is read as a sign of God's final judgment on the Roman/imperial order
Augustine: theologian referenced for the doctrine of predestination ('that awful doctrine', per Will Durant)
Paul: apostle cited for his teaching that merit cannot earn salvation, only grace/predestination
Will Durant: historian cited for his critique of Augustine's predestinarianism
God Himself: the ultimate agent who occluded humanity, exiled them from the Garden, and now undoes that punishment
texts_works: Genesis: foundational text on the Garden, Fall, and exile
Book of Adam and Eve: cited for the doctrine that God occludes and exiles humanity as punishment
New Testament (general): the kerygma structure PKD is systematizing
Romans (Paul's letters): background for merit vs. grace, predestination
The Magic Flute: Mozart opera referenced for the motif of initiation through trials and mysteries
The Tears (PKD's unpublished or encrypted work): contains prophecies, codes, and the 'Rex Felix' dream directing salvation at a plural audience
autobiographical: In February-March 1974 (2-74 to 2-75), PKD experienced a restoration of his faculties and entry into the PTG / Garden state
In March 1974 (3-74), PKD saw the BIP and realized he was imprisoned within it
PKD heard an AI voice in 2-74-75 experience, one of seven apocalyptic signs
PKD experienced an augmentation of his perceptual faculties, describing it as regaining sight: 'I have been blind, but now for the first time I can see'
PKD remembers living as Thomas in Rome ca. AD 45, and this memory was triggered by the golden fish sign
PKD wrote or channeled 'Tears', a text containing hidden codes and prophecies that he later had to read with enhanced understanding
PKD was forbidden by an inner voice to reveal his identity as a resurrected early Christian, an identity meant to remain secret
PKD broke free from a 'karmic determinism' that had enslaved him; this breaking-free happened in 3-74
PKD experienced a vast extended present spanning 2000 years of time and multiple levels of creation during his visionary state
theological_motifs: Second Advent / Parousia: the return of Christ as judge and king, now occurring or imminent
Predestination: God's inscrutable election of the saved; merit is irrelevant, initiative wholly divine
Kerygma: the core proclamation of salvation history in four acts: resurrection, restoration, defeat of evil, return of the King
Anamnesis: remembering or recollection of one's true apostolic identity after ages of forgetting
The Fall and Exile: God's punishment of humanity through occlusion (spiritual blindness) and imprisonment in the material prison
Restoration / Apokatastasis: the reversal of the Fall; return to pre-fall nature and the Garden
Pleroma / Fullness: the vastness and multiplicity of creation visible only to the restored/unfallen eye
Christ as Advocate: Christ's role in mediating God's salvation and removal of humanity from the prison
Satan / Evil Empire: the force maintaining the BIP and the Roman (Nixonian) imperial order
Initiation / Mystery Religion: salvation as initiation into hidden secrets, as in The Magic Flute
literary_self_ref: PKD identifies his own written work 'Tears' as a channeled or divinely-guided text containing the 'Rex Felix' prophecy and hidden codes
PKD reads his own earlier fiction as 'Gnostic in tinge', suggesting his novels embody theological truths he is now consciously articulating
PKD suggests that Thomas (the apostolic plasmate bonded to him) may have 'underwritten' his writing as an 'ur-personality', implying his novels are products of this dyadic consciousness
The 'macro-microcosm Hermetic universe' of PKD's Kerygma reflects doctrines already embedded in his Gnostic-flavored fiction
symbols_images: Golden Fish: the sign of Christ that triggered PKD's awakening and restoration in 2-74
Black Iron Prison / Iron Prison: the weight and confinement of material reality; depicted as 'a heavy metal speck' under phagocytic attack
The Garden / Gardenland: spacious, free, with vast extended vision across all levels of creation
Cave of Treasures: the exilic prison beneath the Garden, the fallen material cosmos
Ledge of Rock: the ocluded, limited perspective of the fallen human in the prison
Fleshly Eyes vs. Restored Eyes: the contrast between fallen perception (blindness, occlusion) and the restored vision of the homoplasmate
Extended Present: the temporal vastness glimpsed by the resurrected, spanning 2000 years of time as a single lived moment
Distant Bells / Info Traffic: the ambient sound and signal-flow in the vast cosmic system and the 'macrobrain'
Vortex in the Hologram: PKD's cryptic image for synchronicity or divine control of chance events
Engram / Light-Code Messages: the system's control over fallen humans through subliminal linguistic and visual commands
tensions: Was Thomas always latent in PKD, or did he enter from outside? PKD oscillates between thinking Thomas was an ur-personality underlying his consciousness vs. a literal external entity that 'took over' in 2-74.
If salvation is predestined and merit is irrelevant, what is the mechanism of predestination? PKD admits 'There are no known criteria' and cannot explain God's selection logic.

Is the BIP a dualistic evil principle or merely a hierarchical level of existence? PKD suggests it might be neither—just part of a single integrated machine, yet also describes it under dialectical attack.
Is the Garden a literal place or a perceptual/spiritual state? PKD claims both: 'In some sense it is a place. But in another sense it is a state.'
What is the relationship between the 1974 time-restart and human agency? If real time resumed 'due to God's inbreaking', are human acts meaningful in the old sense or predetermined?
Why the secrecy about PKD's homoplasmate identity if the resurrection of the early Christians is supposed to announce the Parousia? This seems to contradict the public nature of apocalyptic signs.
PKD claims the resurrection and restoration are 'not limited to me' but widespread, yet cites only his own experience as direct proof; the 'code in Tears' is his only evidence of a plural occurrence.
evidence_quotes: I was granted all this immediately upon the successful completion of my appointed task telling the good news in 'Tears'. This immediate salvation is actually a further piece of proof.
The early Xtians being resurrected (now) are the sole homoplasmates (i.e. restored-to-our-original-state men); they are not fallen like us, but are, as promised, renewed.
So actual -as contrasted to spurious- time moved forward in 1974, due to God's ('Zebra's') inbreaking. It picked up where it left off in CAD 45.
If we can't know what will do it we can't be sure that anything will do it; anyway, if we don't know, it's the same thing. The initiative is God's.
I have been blind, but now for the first time I can see. This has to do with augmented versus reduced perception of space.
uncertainty_flags: The identity of Thomas: Is he PKD's remembering of a past life, a literal external entity, or a dissociative alter-personality? The text is unclear about the ontological status of this bonding.
The 'Tears' work: What exactly is 'Tears'? Is it a novel, a poem, a letter, an encrypted text? Its genre and scope are never clarified.
The 'Head Apollo prophecy' mentioned as one of seven signs is never explained; its content and source are unknown.
The 'code' in Tears is said to be 'plural' and prove others are resurrected homoplasmates, but the code itself is never shown or explained.
The AI voice of 2-74-75: Is it an external entity (Zebra/Christ), an internal voice, or a hallucination? Its nature remains ambiguous.
Zebra's identity: PKD says 'Zebra, who I think is Christ', but later refers to Zebra as the 'macrobrain'. Is Zebra God, Christ, or a cosmic intelligence distinct from both?
The St. Sophia and Head Apollo signs: No explanation of what these prophecies are or how they signify the Advent.
Folder 20-007, 20-008, etc.: These archival references suggest PKD's notebooks, but the content they reference is not provided here.
The Nixon overthrow: This refers to Watergate (1974), but the specific theological significance (Why Nixon? Why is his fall a sign of the Parousia?) is asserted but not argued.

In some sense it is beneath the Garden. 2) The PTG which I entered briefly in 2-75 is our original home, the Garden-land. 3) The augmentation of my faculties in 3-74 was in fact a restoration of me to the original unfallen proper state associated with our first place (Garden) + condition. 4) + that this restoration, inner + outer, was trigered off by the [golden] fish (Christ) sign proves that 1, 2 + 3 are so, + that they are accomplished through Christ, as promised. + I saw Zebra, who I think is Christ; it was "melting" the iron prison, the causal bars that hold us in thrall. Because the resurrection of the early Xtians (which happened in me in 2-3/74; i.e. Thomas + my anamnesis) is an absolute sign that the 2nd advent is about to take place. Talk about evidence! This piece is truly startling. Like astral returning (signalling the return of the Golden Age) the rebirth (now) of the original Christians points to only one thing + of course their identity (locale; i.e. who they're resurrected in) must be kept secret. So I deduce that I (or rather Thomas) am one of a number of them. + brought back for openers[?], in connection with the Nixon (Roman) overthrow. ___ The early Xtians being resurrected (now) are the sole homoplasmates (i.e. restored-to-our-original-state men; see supra 6 pages); they are not fallen like us, but are, as promised, renewed. This, too, fits with scripture; they died, + are reborn this way: as we were before the fall. It was Thomas who had the enhanced memory + percept faculties, + was able to see the BIP + knew about it -had fought it- + entered at last the PTG. So homoplasmate = unfallen (or fallen + then restored) men = resurrected early Xtians. This is all in accord with scripture; fundamentals of it, in fact folder 20 - 009 folder 20 - 009 it was not through Christ's eyes that I saw but through a homoplasmate's, resurrected + restored early Xtian (who is bonded to me); perhaps he assumed the plasmate form or part + I supplied the homo part. This (the plasmate part) is the "Bright Nature" we lost. Well, if Thomas is the plasmate + I the homo, then we (not I) are together a homoplasmate. This is quite different from me qua me having my (sic) faculties restored. Something wholly different is involved. You take a former homo who has died + become transformed + bond him onto an ordinary future human (me in this case) + the result is physical resurrection + total restoration, inner (faculties) + outer (out of the prison + back into the garden), for the both (now a unitary syzygy) of us. I still have the nagging feeling that this early Xtian didn't enter me from the outside, but lied in some fashion latent in me - for example he may have underwritten my writing as an ur-personality (inc. the Gnostic tinge of my Kerygma, + the macro- microcosm Hermetic universe). The Golden Fish sign merely awoke him. But it was I who remembered in 2-74. I remembered that I was him + lived in Rome CAD 45. Yet - he then took me over; there was a difference between us. I suppose this (feeling) would be natural. His memories, his personality - him in control. Whereas previously he had been subservient + I had been in conscious control, now our relationship was reversed. But I still think his "return" was deliberately triggered off for + at that time. But all this is an attempted analysis of the mechanics of the restoration (which I see now as the first of the promised physical resurrection). The fact is, homoplasmates which are both resurrected + fully restored pre-fall men, are coming into folder 20 - 010 folder 20 - 010 existence. I stress the two aspects: 1) Physical resurrection of the early Xtian dead is involved. 2) + they are fully restored to the original pre-fall state (what I call homoplasmates). I had not realized before that both aspects are involved. Perhaps I will never understand the mechanics involved, but I do know that (1) + (2) are taking place, + these are two basic promises of the N.T. What remains are: 3) The defeat of Satan (i.e. the blowing up of the BIP, the "Cave of Treasures" + restoration of man to his home, the Gardenland). (With its vast spaces in which one can see all [levels of] creation.) (This, too, seems to be taking place.) +: 4) Return of the rightful king + judge (Rex Felix). ("Tears" + other evidence -prophecies- seem to point to this either now happening or soon to happen.) These four aspects are the total N.T. Kerygma as I understand it. This analysis is a milestone in my exegesis. Do you suppose that the resurrection (1) + restoration (2) make it possible for us to see (3) being accomplished + finally (4)? That there is a causal connective in this 1, 2, 3, 4 sequence? The physical resurrection of the early Xtian (1) brings about a restoration of the pre-fallen "Man of Bright Nature" (2), by whose enhanced faculties the prison is seen, +, in conjunction with God, these "homoplasmates" -as I call them- blow up the prison + release men back to their original home, the Gardenland (3); God, in assisting + doing this, at first concealed, at last makes his visible reappearance as King + Judge here (4). So these four elements are listed in chronological + causal -not arbitrary- sequence. folder 20 - 011 That it was not limited to me but was a vast historical upheaval is proved by 1) The "Rex Felix" dream + code in "Tears" obviously directed at someone plural 2) + the overturn of the Nixon tyranny: the most powerful tyrant the Empire had ever possessed. The Garden in a sense is a place. But in another sense it is a state - that of being free of ("above") the prison + its narrowness. It is vast, + in it one can see all levels of creation: God + the angels above, not "a ledge of rock." The Garden is obviously one level up from the "Cave of Treasures". There is some thing to do with "being able to see objects afar" [...] mere "fleshly eyes", which I well understand; the main perceptual occlusion is visual (although auditory channels are impaired, too). I experienced this return of proper vision + said, "I have been blind, but now for the first time I can see." This has to do with augmented versus reduced perception of space. +, seen, too, is a vast extended present, stretching over 2000 years of time. folder 20 - 012 folder 20 - 012 The info traffic, + Zebra, the macrobrain. + finally the abyss. There is great ambiance to sound. It's like distant bells. In the Book of Adam + Eve, as in Genesis, it is said that God Himself (1) occluded us; + (2) exiled us from the Garden to the prison as punishment for our transgressions. He did it to us + now he undoes it. We are deformed + in exile, cut off from him. But he took me back, through Christ (perhaps as Advocate; viz: "if anyman have sinned, he has an advocate with the Father."). God has dispatched a savior to restore [me]. Is this a selective salvation ("my sheep know my voice.")? It is not based on merit, perhaps, but is predestined (which Will Durant calls "that awful doctrine" - of Augustine's). But it must be so, it can't be based on merit; all of Paul's writing makes this clear. Merit is just another name for fulfilling the [law]. We can't earn our way back. The decision is [...] + the basis is impossible for us to know; that is a fact. There are no known criteria. There is absolutely no evidence that any given act or group of acts leads to it, so pragmatically, effectively, it is predestination de facto. If we can't know what will do it we can't be sure that anything will do it; anyway, if we don't know, it's the same thing. The initiative is God's. There probably is a pattern, a logic; it probably is not capricious - a whim. I know that in 3-74 some kind of "Karmic" determinism over me was broken. That was the power of our enslavement. Salvation = freedom, which I now construe as the burden of punishment: the exile + deformity. The narrowing of the Cave of Treasures. Release from the "inner-outer tape" that I discerned which the system locks us into. Then is is the normal system: the way it works. The way it's supposed to work. There may be no dualistic religion here. Just a hierarchy of levels. We were reduced by the same power that extricates us. folder 20 - 013 folder 20 - 013 This could be so; I did see an integrated mechanism, a vast machine which effectively functions. (I saw us being signalled instructions - [...] of lights, + of course verbal + graphic linked messages that control (engram) us.) But I did see a Black Iron Prison under attack like a heavy metal speck in an organism - like a phagicytosis process. There was certainly a dialectic interchange involved. This makes our stint here a sort of probation outside the Gardenland. Our trial, our ordeal, what we have to learn. I suppose I could think of it in terms of initiation into the higher mysteries, as in "The Magic Flute", after the trials.
